tags.qa_notes: Re-audited 2026-10-23 against 4 independent domains. Horseshoe Reef (4 km, tobagocays.org), cays list (Petit Tabac lies outside the reef; tobagocays.org), turtle sanctuary around Baradal (thetobagocays.com), green turtles (thediveglobe.com, tourism.gov.vc) confirmed. Depth: thediveglobe.com max 15m/avg 8m; JSON raised from 12 to 15 to match max. REMOVED as not confirmed by any current source: hawksbill turtles, leatherback, nurse sharks, eagle rays, stingrays, 'near-guaranteed' and 'rare elsewhere in Caribbean' wording, 'vibrant coral cover/abundant reef fish'.

Re-audited 2026-10-23. UNRESOLVED: Dive Bequia's site-specific page (divebequia.com/bequia-dive-sites/) now returns 404 and the homepage names no sites, so the previously recorded species list and depth range could not be re-pulled; tripadvisor.com and onecaribbeanusa.com not re-fetched. Search summaries describe a drop-off along Bequia's western tip to roughly 28m with swim-throughs, versus ~30-40m recorded earlier; range stated in text. All species names removed (no current site-specific source confirmed). Fewer than 3 currently-verifiable sources; validated left as-is.

Re-audited 2026-10-23 against 4 independent domains. Confirmed: wall dive with swim-throughs (tourism.gov.vc, bluewater), named for an anchor in the reef (dtmag), 'voted one of top 100' (tourism.gov.vc), frogfish+seahorses (dtmag, thediveglobe, bluewater), ghost pipefish (thediveglobe), eels+squid (bluewater). DEPTH CONFLICT: thediveglobe max 30m/avg 18m vs 36m in JSON - range stated in text, JSON kept at 36. thediveglobe rates beginner; kept Intermediate for wall depth. REMOVED unconfirmed: '18th-century' anchor date, reef starting at 9m, black coral, goldentail moray, porcelain two-spot octopus, lobsters, rays, barracuda, 'consistently' voted.

Re-audited 2026-10-23. UNRESOLVED (2 domains): dtmag.com fetched directly (below Fort Charlotte cliffs, encrusted gin and rum bottles thrown by soldiers, schools of blackbar soldierfish); scubadiving.com confirmed only via search snippet (403 on fetch); divestvincent.com lists the site with no description. REMOVED: '1806' fort date (no current source), 'directly above' wording. Depth 22m unconfirmed by any source - flagged. Prior correction (batfish etc. belong to The Steps) retained as removal.

Re-audited 2026-10-23. UNRESOLVED (2 domains; shorediving.com now 301-redirects to zentacle.com so they count as one). Confirmed: shore entry at Questelles via Leeward Highway, parking ~30ft from water, calm ~95% of time, max current ~2kn strong at the point, 'advanced divers only' past the point, lots of black coral, pristine coral, few large fish (heavy fishing) - zentacle.com; black coral variety - bluewaterdivetravel.com. Coordinates match. NOT RECONFIRMED: 46m max depth and 9m-46m terraced slope (zentacle lists max depth unknown; divessi blog does not mention the site) - JSON depth kept but flagged unverified. REMOVED: sponges, turtle and large-school fish sightings (zentacle says few large fish).

Re-audited 2026-10-23. UNRESOLVED (2 substantive domains; padi.com page only matches coordinates 13.1299,-61.2036, lists generic 'Sharks, Whales, Dolphins, Turtles' and no description). Confirmed: bluewaterdivetravel.com - flying gurnards, frogfish, goldspotted eel, arrow shrimp, blennies/gobies, macro site; divessi.com blog - ~8m depth, pistol shrimp, cardinalfish, torpedo rays, gurnards, seahorses. Depth set 10 -> 8. REMOVED as not reconfirmed (previous note claimed PADI page listed them; current PADI page does not): electric rays, yellowhead jawfish, snake eels, fan worms, red-banded lobster, Fort Duvernette/Indian Bay location, 'encrusted descent line', Bill Tewes attribution.

Re-audited 2026-10-23. Crinoids, garden eels, flamingo tongues confirmed by bluewaterdivetravel.com and tourism.gov.vc (also 'expansive coral reef formation' and 'good drift dive'); Mayreau inside Tobago Cays Marine Park confirmed by tobagocays.org (boundary only, not site description). diveboard.com page has no content and was dropped as a source. Depth 24m not reconfirmed (17-24m range removed from text; JSON flagged unverified). REMOVED unconfirmed: creole wrasse, chubs, horse-eye jacks, eagle rays, barracuda, hawksbill turtles, sharks. Puruni wreck: only bluewaterdivetravel.com found it (1918 gunship, 40ft) so wreck history omitted (<2 sources); it is a separate site.

Re-audited 2026-10-23. UNRESOLVED: scubadiving.com and travel.padi.com returned 403 and petitstvincent.com 404 on fetch; only search-snippet summaries available. Those describe resort-area fauna (rays, nurse/reef sharks, barracuda, lobsters, turtles, scorpionfish, morays, flamingo tongues) for the island's nearby reefs generally, not this site, so ALL species removed. Also removed unreconfirmed: Mission Blue Hope Spot, Marine Conservation Area, CLEAR Caribbean nursery, 'sloping gardens and gentle drop-offs'. Depth 20m unverified. One undated anecdotal review reports algae-covered reef west of PSV; not used. No site-specific sources found; validated left as-is.

Re-audited 2026-10-23. UNRESOLVED (2 domains; mustique-island.com not re-fetched). divemagazine.com confirms the Mustique coral restoration program (Ken Nedimyer, 2015, >12,000 fragments, goal 100,000 by 2030, L'Ansecoy Bay nursery ~8m) but describes snorkel-depth bays, not a dive site called 'Mustique Reef', so its species list was STRIPPED (not site-specific). bluewaterdivetravel.com Mustique entry: sloping reefs, coral expanse, spotted drums, banded coral shrimp, relaxed drift over undamaged corals. REMOVED: 'more than a dozen regular spots', Water Sports Pavilion detail, all DIVE Magazine species. Depth 25m unverified.

Re-audited 2026-10-23 against 4 domains. Confirmed: Buccament/Petit Byahaut location (zentacle, islands.com), hundreds of bats and half-submerged cave chamber, 'one of the most challenging dives in St. Vincent' (bluewater), underwater fissure (tourism.gov.vc), ~300ft underwater tunnel swim only in calm seas/low surge (islands.com). DEPTH CONFLICT: zentacle 32.8ft/10m (rated beginner, shore or boat); search summaries cite Lonely Planet 40-60ft (12-18m) and Discover SVG ~45ft; JSON kept 15, range 10-18m stated. REMOVED as not confirmed: named bat species (Fisherman bat, Fruit bat - islands.com names none), '250-year-old' (islands.com says origins unclear; only a Sandals snippet claims 250 years), first-hand 50ft/60ft account attributed to islands.com. Difficulty kept Advanced (zentacle beginner conflicts).
